description:
Optional enhancement to the adapter-contract I/O surface. Adapters MAY accept a --request <path> argv flag as an alternative to stdin for the complete subcommand. When --request is passed, the adapter reads the request JSON from that file; when absent, stdin is used (current behavior).

=== Why ===
- Replay: the harness already writes invocations/<id>/request.json per §2.3 / §2.10 / §4.4. Pointing the adapter at that file removes a shell-redirect hop and makes deterministic replay trivial.
- Testability: integration tests can hand a file path instead of piping.

=== Scope ===
- Purely additive; stdin path unchanged.
- lernie-provider-anthropic gains --request flag; documented in its --help.
- ARCH §4.4 grows a sentence: "adapters MAY accept --request <path>; invocation semantics identical to stdin". It remains optional; adapters are not required to implement it.
- Harness does NOT change behavior here — it keeps using stdin. Switching the harness to pass --request is a follow-up.

=== Testing ===
Adapter test with a tempfile request.json, assert output matches the stdin path's output for the same input. 100% tarpaulin.
title: Adapter contract: optional file-path input alongside stdin
